newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares surge 1.4 pct, Reliance bucks trend.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares surge 1.4 pct, Reliance bucks trend.

text.p: Delhi shares closed sharply higher on Friday as speculators pocketed profits in Reliance Industries and shifted the funds into other blue chips.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index jumped 12.08 points to 883.81.

Reliance, which had surged 3.0 percent on Thursday after announcing a one-for-one bonus issue, shed 5.20 rupees to 371.25. Some 3.8 million Reliance shares changed hands, about half as many as on Thursday.
"Reliance, which attracted business from other counters yesterday, was the target of some profit-taking by speculators," Harish Gohrotra of Jiwan Funds and Finance said.
"The business diverted to other blue chip companies helped boost market sentiment," another broker said.
Cement maker ACC jumped 65.90 rupees to 1,405.90 on brisk buying by financial houses.
Hindustan Lever shot up 40 rupees to 1,395 on hectic buying by foreign financial institutions.
Ranbaxy Laboratories increased by 29 rupees to 638 on strong buying by speculators and financial houses.
Grasim Industries bucked the trend, shedding 19.50 rupees to 360.50 on profit-taking.
